item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\n# canonical ordering, duplicates, ignored/irrelevant, missing equivalence, complete-state comparison, immutability\\ncases=[\\n ({'declared':['z','a','z','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','name':'same'},'z':{'kind':'dir','entries':['b','a']},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'other':1},'current':{'a':{'name':'same','hash':'2','kind':'file'},'z':{'entries':['b','a'],'kind':'dir'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'other':2}},{'ignored':['skip']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['b','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','b']}),\\n ({'declared':[],'saved':{'x':1},'current':{'x':2}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor r,p,w in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got==w,(got,w); assert r==rb and p==pb\\nreqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); actual=json.load(open('report.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,pol) for r in reqs]; assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)\\nprint('all checks passed',actual)\"]}"}
